patterns.note: Alternating dark and light background sections create a strong visual rhythm and delineate content blocks clearly.
Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings are used for primary section titles, often centered for impact.
High contrast is consistently used with white text on dark backgrounds and dark text on light backgrounds, complemented by a vibrant accent color for calls-to-action.

The hero section's video background scrolls under the main hero text and call-to-action buttons, which remain fixed for a period, creating a layered parallax effect before the entire section scrolls up.

The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent state over the hero to a solid dark background with white text and a more prominent 'Visit a Showroom' button once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections and individual elements (like headings and cards) are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
Testimonial and press sections utilize horizontal carousels to display multiple quotes or mentions efficiently.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling library (likely locomotive-scroll) to enhance the user experience and enable precise scroll-triggered animations.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal content sections, typically involving elements fading or sliding into view from the bottom as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content flow.

The hero section features a video background that scrolls independently or parallaxes behind the main hero text and call-to-action buttons, which remain fixed for a period before the entire section scrolls up.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card borders, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with generous vertical padding between sections and a more compact layout within content cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed video hero that dynamically scrolls away to reveal a solid background while the main hero text remains fixed creates a strong, engaging introduction. The high-contrast dark theme combined with a vibrant accent color gives it a premium, modern feel.
